# FDG3058

> DO add the suffix “Collection,” except for reusable, specialized data types such as “Queue” and “HashSet.”

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.2 Names of Common Types. Applies to: IEnumerable ICollection IList IEnumerable<T> ICollection<T> IList<T>.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1710
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

CA1710 does not know the exception for reusable, specialized data structures. With its default dotnet_code_quality.CA1710.exclude_indirect_base_types = true it does not report a type derived from List<T> or Collection<T>, nor a type that implements only IEnumerable<T> (probe with SDK 10.0.402). Renaming a public type changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1710 has no code fix.
